name: Curaçao
facts: Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands

flag.description: A blue field with a horizontal yellow stripe just below the middle and two white five-pointed stars in the upper hoist, the smaller one nearer the corner.
flag.symbolism: Blue stands for the sea and sky and yellow for the sun; the two stars are Curaçao and its uninhabited neighbour Klein Curaçao, and their five points recall the five continents its people came from.

hook: Curaçao is a deep blue flag cut by one yellow line, with two white stars, one big and one small, floating above it like the island and its little sister.
trivia: Curaçao celebrates Flag Day on 2 July, the date the flag was adopted in 1984.
It became a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands on 10 October 2010, when the Netherlands Antilles was dissolved.
